name: Bad Zwischenahn (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bad Zwischenahn (bulrushes above a well on red and yellow bars).
history: The striped flag shows red in the upper half and gold in the lower half, with the municipal arms at the centre.

features.role: Bad Zwischenahn arms — bulrushes and well
